source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Interior door heights assumed 0-2.1 m; no interior elevation was supplied.
Interior partitions declared on measured line-pair midplanes; drawn 240 mm thicknesses not modelled.
Room uses inferred from furniture; no printed use labels on the plan.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

unresolved: Door swing directions are visible in the plan but leaf state is not modelled.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

scope.actual_openings: only explicit built source openings are inventoried

reused_calibration.basis: Scale from overall chains: 10000 mm across (west outer face px248=0m, east outer face px612=10m) and 20000 mm deep (south outer face py878.5=0m, north outer face py150.5=20m); 27.47 mm/px both axes. North is up (world y grows as pixel y falls). Perimeter declared on observed outer faces; interior dividers on measured line-pair midplanes. Horizontal dividers at 4060/7000/11940 mm from the north outer-face chain = world y 15.94/13.00/8.06 m, matching measured midplanes py 298.5/405.5/585.5. East-side interior walls measured: R2 south wall midplane py360 (y14.25), lobby south wall py700 (y4.90), SE entry wall py753.5 (y3.42). Corridor divider midplanes px401 and px456.5. Edge partitions are carried to the outer-face ring; the drawn 604-612 px band is the 240 exterior wall thickness.

current_claim_state.note: Current numerical/context consistency only; neither retained nor confirmed means drawing truth.

height_coverage.note: Current values, evidence binding and source location, not drawing correctness. A region containing several openings needs individual evidence. Report only.

facade_counts.note: Compare observer-reported whole-floor/facade totals with actual source openings. Uncounted facades, zero totals, conflicting evidence and unresolved scopes stay explicit. Equal counts do not prove position or drawing fidelity. Report only.

L1.rule: min(wall thickness, max(2 pixels, half wall thickness)); scale alone if thickness unknown

building_precision.meaning: Review only; no geometry changed. Align to an existing line, never an average. Real setbacks, voids and narrow spaces require evidence; do not delete partitions or alter connectivity.
